summary: Pure 2D cross product helper. Interprets a1, a2 and a3 as pointers to float points and a4, a5 as coordinate-axis indices, and computes the z-component of the cross product of the edge vectors (a3 - a2) and (a1 - a2) restricted to the two axes, returned as a double. Consumed by F_2D3DTrianglePointTest (0x0054EB40) for signed-area point-in-triangle tests.

operations.description: Compute axis component differences: (a3[axis] - a2[axis]) and (a1[axis] - a2[axis]) for each of the two coordinate indices a5 and a4, reading floats at 4 * index offsets.
Form the 2D cross product: dx1 * dy2 - dy1 * dx2 using the four axis-aligned edge components.
Return the scalar cross-product value as a double.
